items.note: Χριστοῦ· (Christou) 'Christ;' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
Χριστοῦ (Christou) 'Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
Χριστοῦ (Christou) 'Christ' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of κυρίου. (kuriou) 'Lord.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἁμαρτίας (hamartias) 'of sin' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἀνομίας, (anomias) 'of lawlessness,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὡς θεὸν (hōs theon) 'as god' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ἰησοῦς (Iēsous) 'Jesus' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
καὶ (kai) 'and' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ὁ (ho) 'the' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)

ἀμήν.¶ πρός Θεσσαλονικείς δευτέρᾳ ἐγράφη ἀπό Ἀθηνῶν (amēn pros Thessalonikeis deutera egraphē apo Athēnōn) 'Amen. to Thessalonica second it was written from Athens' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
